record_title: Sharp min-max correlation over three-point probability weights
provenance: An exact optimization of Pearson correlation between the minimum and maximum of two iid draws over all probability weights on three equally spaced support points.
limitations: Specific to three equally spaced support points, sample size two, and the extreme order-statistic pair; no claim for larger supports, other order pairs, arbitrary support locations, nonlinear maximal correlation, or sampling without replacement; residual terminology/indexing risk remains.
